title: Selected Topics in Biology; Advanced Cellular Neuroscience
description: Prerequisite: C- or better in BSCI353; recommended, C- or betterin BSCI440 or another upper-level neuroscience course. (Sponsoring Dept: BIOL). Applicable to Biological Sciences specialization areas: GENB and PHNB. Readings and discussion in cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying neural circuit development and function.
